notes.title: Deck of Souls is now out in full release!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We are thrilled to announce that Deck of Souls is now complete and officially launching today!

[previewyoutube=lfhixwjhGa8;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new in this update:
[list]
[*] Chapter 5, featuring the finale of the story.
[*] The ultimate boss, Satan.
[*] Five challenging sub-bosses.
[*] A new biome and enemies to conquer.
[/list]
We deeply appreciate everyone who has supported us throughout the game’s development. Your comments and feedback have been invaluable in making Deck of Souls more engaging and enjoyable for all players.

Play the game, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to leave a review on Steam!

Regards, 
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Play the first Early Access update for Deck of Souls!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

We've implemented all of the changes and we're finally ready to unveil the first Early Access update for Deck of Souls!

What's new: 
[list]
[*] Three new enemies in the city;
[*] Two new backgrounds – with visual effects – for the city;
[*] Five new relics. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/690df6c6df7dd175b4314fd3c92ebf911bda7e58.png[/img]

We have also prepared a number of QoL improvements based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Provided clarity on the order in which cards are played. We hope there will be no more issues with this. 
[*] Accelerated animations. You can now select the speed in the game settings.
[*] Added description of the conditions to unlock new classes.
[*] Removed the need to select a class after finishing the tutorial. 
[*] It is now clear which items can and cannot be upgraded..
[*] Updated the localization for several languages.
[*] And several other changes.
[/list]

Download the updated version, share your feedback with us here or on [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url], send the link to the game to your friends, and just have fun with it. 

Thank you to everyone who supports Deck of Souls, you help us to create the best game possible. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Release trailer and Early Access release date for Deck of Souls!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

Get ready for the battle between Heaven and Hell when Deck of Souls releases into Early Access on June 20th! Arm yourself by watching the game's release trailer.

[previewyoutube=bzCopKJIGa8;full][/previewyoutube]

Deck of Souls' Early Access will contain: 
[list]
[*] 3 classes of heroes - Holy Lich, Divine Knight, and Saint Talon, including numerous cards for each of them. There will be 77 cards for Holy Lich, 61 cards for Warrior, 64 cards for Saint Talon, and 32 neutral cards. 
[*] 3 incredible story chapters to replay over and over again.
[*] 3 deadly bosses, each with two unique stages and challenging two-stage battles. 
[*] 3 different merchants.
[*] Unique items for each class, consisting of 28 items for the Holy Lich, 19 for the Saint Talon, 28 for the Warrior, 9 neutral items, and 7 relics. 
[*] 55 unique combat encounters, including bosses and random events. 
[*] 83 different nodes that treasure-filled glory or deadly combat encounters. 
[*] Over 140 different passives, but you'll have to play the game to uncover all of them!
[/list]
Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist and subscribe to the Steam page so you don't miss the release of the game. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Devlog #2: Book of Souls, many changes to mechanics, and new cards
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The development of Deck of Souls is well underway and progressing smoothly. The Book of Souls is almost complete and will show players an overview of their card collection and overall game progress.

We have also added brand new cards, a discard pile, starter decks for the Rogue and Warrior classes, and four new starter decks for the Caster class (bringing it up to six!).

And we have started work on improving the interface. If you have already played the Deck of Souls demo, we would love to hear your thoughts and ideas about the interface – it will greatly help us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/edde8d0b8bfe78443b8ec097e1768ca698e33e26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/f0ef4702f51eb4ec403a616317768f08f0993188.png[/img]

There are also several changes to card mechanics:
[list]
[*] Stealth is now lost when dealing damage;
[*] Snack Attack makes the card instant when in stealth;
[*] Rush cards are now automatically applied if they are added to the deck and if the Rush value this turn allows it.
[*] You can no longer draw the same card twice. Once the deck is completely drawn, it will recharge from the discard pile. It's possible to have an empty deck and draw no cards.
[/list]
We've made the following additional changes:
[list]
[*] Added new cards;
[*] Cards now display the class they belong to;
[*] Added mechanics that enable players to discover and search for cards in the deck;
[*] An indicator to show player damage increases;
[*] Added effects for cards.
[/list]
Thank you for supporting Deck of Souls! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/fBSFex4YvT]Discord[/url] to share your impressions and chat with other players and the developer. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team
